grades.quote: Investigations will follow procedures outlined in College policy and/or employee collective agreements as applicable.
The College will make reasonable efforts to ensure that every member of the College community is aware of this policy.
Any member of the College community may make a Formal Complaint about sexualized violence or misconduct that falls within the scope of this policy.
A person may report an incident of sexualized violence or misconduct to the police anytime.
